sn1.17:1.1:
For the inexperienced,
the contemplative life is
hard to do,
hard to endure,
sn1.17:1.3: for many are the confinements there
sn1.17:2.1:
How many days can you follow
the contemplative life
sn1.17:2.2: if you don’t block the mind?
sn1.17:2.4: under the sway of your resolves.
sn1.17:3.2:
As a tortoise would draw
its limbs
into its shell,
so a monk should—
the thoughts of his heart.
sn1.17:3.4:
totally unbound,
he shouldn’t disparage
anyone at all.
